instructions: Squeeze 2 tbsp of juice from the lemon into a small bowl. Mince the garlic clove and add it with the 1 tsp oregano, the 1/2 tsp salt and the 1/4 tsp pepper.
Whisk in the 2 tbsp olive oil until the dressing comes together.
Drain and rinse the can of chickpeas, shake off the water and put them in a large bowl.
Chop the red, yellow and green bell peppers into bite-size pieces. Dice 1/4 cup of the red onion. Add them to the bowl.
Halve the cucumber lengthwise, cut each half lengthwise again and slice it. Halve 15 of the grape tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with 1/3 cup of the kalamata olives.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until everything is coated.
Crumble the 4 oz feta over the top and fold it in gently so it stays in pieces.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of the lemon.
Pack it into 4 lidded containers and keep them in the fridge. It keeps for up to 3 days.
method_notes: Both versions toss canned chickpeas with bell pepper, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, kalamata olives and feta in a lemon, garlic, olive oil and dried oregano dressing. Ambitious Kitchen (the lead) uses one can of chickpeas with three colors of bell pepper for four servings and lets it sit an hour if there's time; The Kitchen Girl adds red wine vinegar, Dijon and parsley and uses one red pepper. This follows the lead's amounts at its own 4 servings, packed into containers for lunches.
